mapper.insert: insert ignore into sys_work_calendar_year (calendar_year, version, create_time, update_time, create_by, update_by, deleted) values (#{calendarYear}, 0, current_timestamp, current_timestamp, #{operatorId}, #{operatorId}, 0)
mapper.select: select * from sys_work_calendar_year where calendar_year = #{calendarYear} and deleted = 0 for update
